mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, application_id, process_id, process_version_id, process_code, subject_object_code, subject_record_id, business_key, trigger_type, source_event_id, idempotency_key, actor_type, actor_user_id, active_org_id, status, current_node_id, flow_process_instance_id, context_snapshot, retry_count, next_retry_time, error_code, error_summary, start_time, end_time, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_business_process_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_key = #{businessKey} AND flow_process_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND flow_process_instance_id != '' ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ai_business_process_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ( status = 'PENDING' OR (status IN ('RUNNING', 'WAITING') AND update_time <= #{before}) OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_time IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_time <= #{before}) ) ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 2 WHEN 'WAITING' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, COALESCE(next_retry_time, update_time) ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_process_run SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, end_time = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetryCount}
